title: Canonical evaluation on the single-complex homology generator
statement: Let k be a commutative ring, n an integer, and A an object of the chosen derived category of ModuleCat k [def-weil-derived-category-cohomology-functor]. Put S(n) equal to the single free rank-one complex in degree n. Define c(n) in H^n(Q(S(n))) by applying homologyFunctorFactors.inv to singleObjHomologySelfIso.inv(1). Define the k-linear map cupHomologyEvaluation from Hom(Q(S(n)),A) to H^n(A) by f mapping to H^n(f)(c(n)). Linearity of the homology functor is [lem-sc-module-cup-homology-functor-linear].

proof.text: Construct the generator by the inverse single-complex homology isomorphism followed by the inverse homology factorization. Apply the homology functor to the morphism and evaluate at that generator. Functorial k-linearity gives additivity and compatibility with scalars.

proof_origin.note: M1 second-reading repair: explicit canonical evaluation; no arbitrary equivalence is normalized.

def cupHomologyEvaluation (A : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (n : ℤ) :
    (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((HomologicalComplex.single
      (ModuleCat.{u} k) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n).obj (ModuleCat.of k k)) ⟶ A) →ₗ[k]
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} k) n).obj A
